measures.期末安全庫存量:
VAR d = MAX(FactInventory[快照日期])
					RETURN
						CALCULATE(
							SUM(FactInventory[安全庫存量]),
							KEEPFILTERS(FactInventory[快照日期] = d)
						)
measures.快照預測數量:
VAR d = MAX(FactInventory[快照日期])
					RETURN
						CALCULATE(
							SUM(FactInventory[預測數量]),
							KEEPFILTERS(FactInventory[快照日期] = d)
						)
measures.快照需求數量:
VAR d = MAX(FactInventory[快照日期])
					RETURN
						CALCULATE(
							SUM(FactInventory[需求數量]),
							KEEPFILTERS(FactInventory[快照日期] = d)
						)
measures.欠交數量:
SUMX(
						FactShipment,
						MAX(
							FactShipment[採購數量] - FactShipment[交付數量],
							0
						)
					)
measures.履約異常型別:
IF(
						HASONEVALUE(FactShipment[運單號]),
						VAR Late = MAX(FactShipment[延遲天數]) > 0
						VAR Short = [欠交數量] > 0
						RETURN
							SWITCH(
								TRUE(),
								Late && Short, "遲到且欠交",
								Late, "遲到",
								Short, "欠交",
								"正常"
							)
					)
measures.不合格數量:
VAR Q = [收貨數量]
					RETURN
						IF(
							NOT ISBLANK(Q),
							Q - [合格數量]
						)
measures.補貨風險提示:
IF(
						NOT ISBLANK([庫存金額]),
						SWITCH(
							TRUE(),
							[建議補貨量] > 0 && [呆滯庫存金額] > 0, "補貨與慢動並存",
							[建議補貨量] > 0, "補貨候選",
							[呆滯庫存金額] > 0, "慢動複核",
							"正常"
						)
					)
measures.當前期間說明:
VAR MinSelectedDate = MIN(DimDate[日期])
					VAR MaxSelectedDate = MAX(DimDate[日期])
					VAR Snap = MAX(FactInventory[快照日期])
					RETURN
						IF(
							ISBLANK(MinSelectedDate),
							"當前篩選無日期",
							FORMAT(
								MinSelectedDate,
								"yyyy-MM"
							) & "—" & FORMAT(
								MaxSelectedDate,
								"yyyy-MM"
							)
						)
						& IF(
							ISBLANK(Snap),
							" · 無庫存快照",
							" · 庫存截至" & FORMAT(
								Snap,
								"yyyy-MM-dd"
							)
						) & " · 模擬資料"
